# Setup

```{r setup, warning=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(haven)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(tidyverse)
    library(mirt)
    library(psych)
})

# mirt parallel compute
mirtCluster(4)

# Load datasets
plt_gemini <- read_csv("../data/plt_constraints.csv", show_col_types = F)

# data aggregation
plt_gemini <- plt_gemini %>%
    mutate(
        entry_3_prediction = case_when(
            entry_prediction %in% c(0, 1) ~ 0,
            entry_prediction == 4 ~ 1,
            entry_prediction %in% c(2, 3, 5, 7, 8) ~ 2,
            entry_prediction %in% c(6, 9) ~ 3
        ),
        exit_3_prediction = case_when(
            exit_prediction %in% c(3, 4, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13) ~ 0,
            exit_prediction %in% c(5, 6) ~ 1,
            exit_prediction == 0 ~ 2,
            exit_prediction %in% c(1, 2) ~ 3
        ),
        checks_prediction = checks_local_prediction + checks_military_prediction +
            checks_judiciary_prediction + checks_council_prediction +
            checks_bureaucracy_prediction + checks_aristocracy_prediction +
            checks_assembly_prediction + checks_bourgeoisie_prediction +
            checks_clergy_prediction,
        elections_raw_prediction = elections_prediction,
        elections_prediction = if_else(assembly_prediction == 2,
                                       elections_prediction,
                                       NA_real_),
        across(c(exit_prediction, entry_prediction), ~na_if(., 99)))

plt_gemini %>%
    group_by(entry_3_prediction) %>%
    summarise(
        n = n(),
        rest = mean(sovereign_prediction + constitution_prediction + federalism_prediction +                      checks_prediction + collegiality_prediction + petition_prediction +                           assembly_prediction + elections_prediction, na.rm = TRUE))

#===============================================================================
# IRT: item sets
#===============================================================================

# Version A: all 19 indicators
items_A <- c(
    "constitution_prediction",
    "sovereign_prediction",
    "federalism_prediction",
    "collegiality_prediction",
    "petition_prediction",
    "assembly_prediction",
    "elections_prediction",
    "symbolism_prediction",
    "entry_3_prediction",
    "exit_3_prediction",
    "checks_local_prediction",
    "checks_military_prediction",
    "checks_judiciary_prediction",
    "checks_council_prediction",
    "checks_bureaucracy_prediction",
    "checks_aristocracy_prediction",
    "checks_assembly_prediction",
    "checks_bourgeoisie_prediction",
    "checks_clergy_prediction"
)

# Version B: Checks_prediction aggregation
items_B <- c(
    "constitution_prediction",
    "sovereign_prediction",
    "federalism_prediction",
    "collegiality_prediction",
    "petition_prediction",
    "assembly_prediction",
    "elections_prediction",
    "symbolism_prediction",
    "entry_3_prediction",
    "exit_3_prediction",
    "checks_prediction"
)

# checks_prediction is sparse after 7 (8: n = 189 (0.14%), 9: n = 33 (0.02%))
# combine 7/8/9 to "7+" (1,274 in total)
COLLAPSE_CHECKS_TOP <- TRUE

plt_gemini <- plt_gemini %>%
    mutate(checks_prediction = if (COLLAPSE_CHECKS_TOP) {
        pmin(checks_prediction, 7)
    } else {
        checks_prediction
    })

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# helper: item matrix & itemtype. Mixed with "2PL" and "graded"
# recoded to K-1
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
make_irt_data <- function(df, items) {
    dat <- df %>% select(all_of(items)) %>% as.data.frame()
    
    for (v in items) {
        x <- dat[[v]]
        lv <- sort(unique(x[!is.na(x)]))
        cat(sprintf("%-32s n_cat=%d  levels=%s  NA=%d (%.1f%%)\n",
                    v, length(lv), paste(lv, collapse = ","),
                    sum(is.na(x)), 100 * mean(is.na(x))))
        dat[[v]] <- match(x, lv) - 1L   # recoded to 0, 1 ... K-1
    }
    dat
}

get_itemtype <- function(dat) {
    vapply(dat, function(x) {
        k <- length(unique(x[!is.na(x)]))
        if (k <= 2) "2PL" else "graded"
    }, character(1))
}

cat("\n===== Version A items =====\n")
dat_A <- make_irt_data(plt_gemini, items_A)
type_A <- get_itemtype(dat_A)

cat("\n===== Version B items =====\n")
dat_B <- make_irt_data(plt_gemini, items_B)
type_B <- get_itemtype(dat_B)

print(type_A)
```

# IRT Model

```{r}
set.seed(42)

mod_A <- mirt(dat_A, model = 1, itemtype = type_A,
              method = "EM", SE = TRUE,
              technical = list(NCYCLES = 2000))

mod_B <- mirt(dat_B, model = 1, itemtype = type_B,
              method = "EM", SE = TRUE,
              technical = list(NCYCLES = 2000))

saveRDS(mod_A, "./mod_A_unidim.rds")
saveRDS(mod_B, "./mod_B_unidim.rds")

#===============================================================================
# Evaluation
#===============================================================================
coef_A <- coef(mod_A, simplify = TRUE, IRTpars = TRUE)$items
coef_B <- coef(mod_B, simplify = TRUE, IRTpars = TRUE)$items

round(coef_A, 3)
round(coef_B, 3)


coef_A %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("item") %>%
    select(item, a) %>%
    arrange(desc(a)) %>%
    print()

summary(mod_A)
summary(mod_B)
```

## Check Indicator Order

```{r}
graded_items <- names(type_B)[type_B == "graded"]

for (it in graded_items) {
    a_it <- coef_B[it, "a"]
    b <- coef_B[it, grep("^b[0-9]", colnames(coef_B))]
    b <- b[!is.na(b)]
    ok <- if (a_it >= 0) all(diff(b) > 0) else all(diff(b) < 0)
    cat(sprintf("%-32s a = %6.3f   b = %-28s ordered? %s\n",
                it, a_it, paste(round(b, 3), collapse = "  "), ok))
}
```

## Local Dependence Problem (assembly; check_assembly; elections)

```{r}
q3_full <- residuals(mod_A, type = "Q3", verbose = FALSE)
q3_pairs <- as.data.frame(as.table(q3_full)) %>%
    filter(as.character(Var1) < as.character(Var2)) %>%
    rename(item1 = Var1, item2 = Var2, Q3 = Freq) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(Q3)))
head(q3_pairs, 20)

q3_full_B <- residuals(mod_B, type = "Q3", verbose = FALSE)
q3_pairs <- as.data.frame(as.table(q3_full_B)) %>%
    filter(as.character(Var1) < as.character(Var2)) %>%
    rename(item1 = Var1, item2 = Var2, Q3 = Freq) %>%
    # mutate(Q3 = Q3 - 0.1) %>% # adjust negative expectation 
    arrange(desc(abs(Q3)))
head(q3_pairs, 20)
```

```{r}
plt_gemini %>%
    count(sovereign_prediction, exit_3_prediction) %>%
    group_by(sovereign_prediction) %>%
    mutate(prop = round(n / sum(n), 3)) %>%
    select(-n) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = sovereign_prediction,
                       values_from = prop,
```

```{r}
# see if the second dimension shares similar trend with year
mod2 <- mirt(dat_B, 2, itemtype = type_B, method = "EM", rotate = "oblimin")
f <- fscores(mod2, method = "EAP")

cor(f[, 2], plt_gemini$leader_first_year, use = "complete.obs") 
summary(mod2)  

# check symbolism labeling
it_nosym <- unname(type_B)[items_B != "symbolism_prediction"]
mod_nosym <- mirt(dat_B[, items_B != "symbolism_prediction"], 1,
                  itemtype = it_nosym, method = "EM")
plt_gemini %>%
    mutate(th_ns = fscores(mod_nosym, method = "EAP")[, 1]) %>%
    group_by(symbolism_prediction) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), theta = mean(th_ns, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(theta)
```

```{r}
plot(mod_B, type = "info") 
plot(mod_B, type = "SE")

th <- fscores(mod_B, method = "EAP", full.scores = TRUE, full.scores.SE = TRUE)

plt_gemini %>%
    mutate(theta = th[, "F1"], se = th[, "SE_F1"],
           era = cut(leader_first_year,
                     breaks = c(-Inf, 500, 1500, 1800, Inf),
                     labels = c("Ancient","Medieval","EarlyModern","Modern"))) %>%
    group_by(era) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), mean_theta = mean(theta), mean_se = mean(se))

```

## Theta

```{r}
fs_A <- fscores(mod_A, method = "EAP", full.scores = TRUE, full.scores.SE = TRUE)
fs_B <- fscores(mod_B, method = "EAP", full.scores = TRUE, full.scores.SE = TRUE)

# empirical reliability
empirical_rxx(fs_A)
empirical_rxx(fs_B)

plt_gemini <- plt_gemini %>%
    mutate(theta_A = fs_A[, "F1"], theta_A_se = fs_A[, "SE_F1"],
           theta_B = fs_B[, "F1"], theta_B_se = fs_B[, "SE_F1"])

cor(plt_gemini$theta_A, plt_gemini$theta_B, use = "complete.obs", method = "spearman")

# Simple sum
plt_gemini <- plt_gemini %>%
    mutate(simple_sum = rowSums(across(all_of(items_A)), na.rm = TRUE))

cor(plt_gemini$theta_A, plt_gemini$simple_sum, use = "complete.obs")

ggplot(plt_gemini, aes(x = theta_A, y = theta_B)) +
    geom_hex(bins = 60) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "log10") +
    labs(x = "theta (Version A: 19 items)",
         y = "theta (Version B: checks summed)") +
    theme_minimal()
```

## Face Validity Check

```{r}
# mirtCluster(remove = TRUE)
# Era
plt_gemini %>%
    mutate(era = cut(leader_first_year,
                     c(-3000, 0, 1000, 1500, 1800, 1900, 2030),
                     labels = c("pre-0", "0-1000", "1000-1500",
                                "1500-1800", "1800-1900", "1900+"))) %>%
    group_by(era) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), theta = mean(theta_A, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    print(n = Inf)

# Polity (It seems like it depends on the length of that polity as well)
plt_gemini %>%
    group_by(polity_name) %>%
    filter(n() >= 30) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), theta = mean(theta_A, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(desc(theta)) %>%
    print(n = 20)


# Known polities
plt_gemini %>%
    filter(polity_name %in% c("Roman Republic","Athens","Venice","England",
                              "Russia","Prussia","Ottoman Empire","China",
                              "Soviet Union","Germany","Japan","France", "United States Of America")) %>%
    group_by(polity_name) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), theta = mean(theta_A, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(desc(theta)) %>% print(n = Inf)
```
